entities.summary: Augustine Hu Daguo was the underground Roman Catholic bishop of the Apostolic Prefecture of Shiqian, Shiqian (Shihtsien), Guizhou, China. The Apostolic Prefecture of Shiqian is a suffragan see in the Province of the Archdiocese of Guiyang.
